quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will curve right and then left. Slow down before you reach these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane from the right side.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it signals that the rider is slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down and be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that a side road is ahead and traffic may enter from that direction.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider's left arm is extended straight to the left, it signals a left turn or left lane change.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign prevents:

options.text: Wrong-way entry on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wrong-way entry on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you not to enter because the road has one-way traffic in the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a school zone is ahead. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are reserved for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic only moves in one direction on this road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road surface is slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means you cannot do that action. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When an operator extends their left arm straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: A left arm extended straight out means the driver is planning to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this work zone.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before entering the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you are not allowed to make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a railroad crossing where the road is at a steep slope. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop.
Stop completely, then go only if it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection, but you may not need to stop.
Stop only if there is traffic on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go only if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always stop completely. You can only go when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.
A bump is in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They tell drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet, making it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp right turn is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a sharp right turn is coming up ahead.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Work on the highway is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Work on the highway is ahead.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange and warn drivers of hazards in work areas. This sign tells you that construction or maintenance work is ahead. Slow down and drive with extra care.

questions.question: This sign indicates that:

options.text: No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
Trucks are on an upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or steep downgrade is coming up.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you cannot turn left.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
Detour to the right because of roadwork.
Slow down because the road changes direction sharply.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road changes direction sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead turns sharply. Slow down before the sharp turn, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even without a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always give pedestrians the right of way at crosswalks. Watch carefully for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up, so you need to get ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow and black warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (in this case, 13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders in a group communicate. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with their palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. In this case, it prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Yellow and black warning signs alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that bicycles may cross your path. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. The arrow shows the direction of the bicycle path. Drive carefully in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that when turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. Turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does this hand signal mean? The lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger upward.

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders in a group communicate. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger, all riders should move into a single-file line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes moving in the same direction will become one lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or steering, and increase distance from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders in a group communicate. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up and swings it upward, it means the group should increase speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down to their side, riders following should slow down.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a train crossing is ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what should you do?

options.text: You can either exit or continue straight through.
You can stay in your lane and continue straight.
You must exit if you stay in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit if you stay in this lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane leaves the freeway. You must either exit or move to another lane to continue on the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black marks. This sign warns you a traffic light is coming. Be ready for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing up, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to show turns or stops. A left arm bent at the elbow and pointing up means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right or go straight.
You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black marks or letters. They warn you about special situations or hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black marks and prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns of a sharp turn ahead. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop. Look for pedestrians and traffic crossing the intersection. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that people may be crossing the road here. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection. Be ready to stop if needed. Let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that an intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic is entering from the right. Be ready to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is coming. Enter at a low speed and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a traffic signal is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What is the order of traffic light colors from bottom to top?
questions.explanation: From bottom to top, traffic lights are ordered green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a curve in the road is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you to stay on the right side to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. If your left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it means you plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic signals, red is always on top and green is always on bottom. On horizontal signals, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns that a T intersection is coming and you should prepare to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show rules that drivers must follow. This sign means right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at any intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a winding road with three or more curves is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns that an area with low clearance is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves to the right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
A divided highway is beginning. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves to the right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right. You should slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign, which is 35 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: One lane is ending. The right lane will close soon.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.
One lane is ending. The left lane will close soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: One lane is ending. The right lane will close soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane must turn left.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that right turns are not allowed. You must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck safely.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that the bridge ahead is narrow. You should be careful and avoid passing trucks on or before the bridge.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: These chevron signs point in the direction the road curves. This one shows a sharp left curve. There may be several signs placed throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
Only certain turns are allowed from certain lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers can use it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers are on or near the road.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Be prepared to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends. Traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane will end. Traffic in the right lane must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter from your current direction. Turn around and find a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic even when the light is green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic even when the light is green.
questions.explanation: This sign with a traffic light tells drivers turning left that they must wait for oncoming traffic to pass, even though their light is green.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing in front of you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is near.
Look both ways before crossing the intersection.
Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach the intersection. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign tells drivers to stay to the right of a traffic island, median, or barrier ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves only to the right.
The road curves right, then left.
The road curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the road ahead curves to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply right and then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is showing red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is showing green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a traffic signal at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot park here. You must obey all regulation signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This eight-sided sign means you must stop. Look both ways and yield the right-of-way before proceeding when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a divider. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The safe speed for a residential area.
The safe speed for exiting a highway.
The safe speed for entering a highway.
The safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed for exiting a highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed to use when exiting a highway. The number shown is the recommended maximum speed.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass only at night.

questions.explanation: This white rectangular sign is a regulation sign. You must obey it. You cannot pass other vehicles where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Only stop if you must.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn here.

questions.question: What should you be most concerned about when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may be misaligned because one side of your car is higher than the other.
You may damage a tire if you drift onto the shoulder.
You may hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You may lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road hazards. This sign tells you the road may become slippery when wet. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for trains to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: The posted speed limit shows:

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all road and weather conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit in bad weather or poor conditions. Always adjust your speed to be safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is moving in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
